svg.title: Speedup by task
svg.desc: Median speedup, plain bash over indo, 3 runs each. All tests 3.3x (53.0s plain, 16.1s indo); Failing and behind 3.3x (55.4s plain, 16.8s indo); Python tests 2.1x (31.7s plain, 14.8s indo); JavaScript tests 1.8x (24.0s plain, 13.5s indo); Go tests 1.2x (6.9s plain, 5.6s indo); git fetch 1.1x (5.0s plain, 4.5s indo); Pull 6, then test 1.1x (14.8s plain, 14.0s indo); git status 0.8x (4.2s plain, 5.0s indo). Six slow tasks pooled: 1.8x (95% CI 1.4x to 2.3x). One plain Go run of 355s is excluded from that pool.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1x is no change. Bars that pass the line are faster. Median of 3 runs.

svg.text: 6 slow tasks together: 1.8x (95% CI 1.4x to 2.3x). git status got slower. Fetch, and a pull of 6 repos, barely moved.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: * Go median is 6.9s. One plain bash run took 355s and is left out of the 1.8x pool. With it, that pool is 2.25x.
